label: Drag City
release_notes: Ty Segall's 18th solo studio album, billed as one of his heaviest.
Recorded mostly live with Ben Boye, Evan Burrows, Mikal Cronin and Emmett Kelly, plus Bitchin Bajas' Cooper Crain.
Same-day companion Love Fuzzz EP (Twins cover plus My Pet Guru).
Louder Than War Album of the Week. Nine tracks, about 33 minutes.
draft_comment: Ty goes heavy. Mostly cut live with the band, fuzz pinned in the red, with a couple of crooner turns. Big, dumb, glorious riffs.

tracks.title: Hospital
tracks.notes: Opener; quiet/loud dirge into a twin-guitar solo (reviews).

tracks.title: Black Paint
tracks.notes: Lead single (June 2026); in the Oct. 8 plan.

tracks.title: Glass
tracks.notes: Proggy and metallic; Mikal Cronin's bass in heavy modulated fuzz; guitar duel mid-song.

tracks.title: Play Cowboys
tracks.notes: Psych ballad with keyboards; Ty croons.

tracks.title: Chrome
tracks.notes: Title track closer, the longest at 5:08.
